title: Performance Audits, StateKey Interning, DenseIndex & Benchmark Suite

primary_concerns: High (HashDoS / Cold Cliff): docs/perf_audits.md documents replacing SipHash with non-cryptographic foldhash (FastMap/FastSet) on internal maps keyed by external network-supplied EventIds/state_keys, exposing a HashDoS vector if an attacker grinds colliding IDs; additionally, O(1) Arc::ptr_eq fast paths experience a cold-deserialization performance cliff after process restart or cache eviction.

High (Degradation at Scale & Open Test Debt): docs/tech_debt.md documents that Arc<str>-backed InternedKey suffers +3% to +16% performance degradation at 5,000+ room members due to cross-core atomic refcount cache-line contention, while u32 arena interning (InternId) remains parked on a HRTB lifetime bound, and multi-round bucket-split retry lacks a deterministic E2E test.
Low (Tooling Hygiene): docs/format.sh invokes an unpinned global prettier binary with blind --write . across docs/.
